verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own data-extraction paths. Admins can 'pull full spend exports' through MCP. The CLI's --agent mode outputs JSON, and a 174-path Developer API (with a public OpenAPI schema) retrieves transactions and other resources. There is no documented bulk 'export all my data' or account-exit feature, so the 'all data' and 'leave' parts of the story go unproven. Missing for 10: a documented complete account-data export covering every object type, explicit open-format bulk export files (e.g. CSV/JSON archive), offboarding/data-portability documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
